body:
sara: Heads-up: new Dedicated micro-pool policy and initial micro-pool launch in ap-southeast-3 (Singapore). Purpose: serve many small, low-memory models efficiently and reduce fragmentation in larger pools. Launching pilot now.

ben: What do you mean by micro-pool?

sara: Micro-pools are smaller node groups (6 GPUs) optimized for 2-4B models and embedding workloads. Pool id: pool-micro-sgp-01. Hardware: mix of rtx8000 + l4s. Billing tag: `dedicated:micro.ap-southeast-3`.

ops-bot: [automation] create_pool start: pool_id=pool-micro-sgp-01, nodes=6, owner=@sara

amanda: Ops notes:
- micro-pools have independent autoscale windows (min=1, max=6)
- routing will prefer micro pools when request_fit <= 6GB memory
- fallback to standard pools if auto-scale fails

infra: Any quota impact?

sara: Quotas will roll under the existing dedicated family but we added a `micro_separate_quota` flag for customers who opt into micro-only capacity. Sales/Support to enable per-account on request.

ben: UI/API changes?

sara: Console: new checkbox "Prefer micro-pools" under Dedicated pool selection. API: `preferred_pool_size=micro` in CreateRoute.

amanda: SRE checklist:
1) Monitor micro-pool-util and micro-pool-ooms
2) If queue latency > 200ms for 5m, increase micro pool cap or route to larger pools
3) If autoscale thrash (scale up/down > 3 times in 10m), lock scaling for 15m

ops-bot: [automation] create_pool complete: pool_id=pool-micro-sgp-01, state=active, nodes=6

sara: Pilot behavior: available to Dedicated customers in Singapore region only. Will enable marketplace tile "Micro Dedicated (pilot)". Pricing is 25% below standard per-GPU rate due to smaller overhead.

tom: Runtime notes: quantized kernels supported. Recommend batch sizes <= 64 for best latency.

ben: Any GA timeline?

sara: Pilot duration 6 weeks. After metrics review, decide GA. Action items:
- infra: ensure billing tag flows to invoices (ETA 3h)
- docs: publish pilot FAQ and opt-in form (ETA 6h)
- sre: add dashboard widgets (ETA 2h)
- sales: tag eligible customers and prepare marketplace tile (ETA 4h)

amanda: Acknowledged. I'll add monitors now.

ops-bot: [audit] announcement_posted by sara at 1930456789

sara: Update @here — pool live and pilot opt-in link posted in product-notifications. Will share perf snapshots after 24h. Closing thread.
